answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 300 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is logged against the cipher challenge, the ridge audit can replay the oasis history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 754 identities would post 1384 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
